name: Carol Park Mausoleum
elevationDatum: Rigid local foundation y=0; real metres +X east, +Y up, +Z south. Two mapped controls fix rotation, baked into the geometry once. No terrain or Mercator stretch.
note: Five slender red-granite arches form an open pentagonal crown above a stepped dark-granite rotunda and pale circular foundation. The museum publishes 48 m while OSM upper parts end at 46.7 m; the published total is used and arch spring/section dimensions are photo estimates. Five crown planes follow the mapped pentagonal support arrangement. The pale outer footing is estimated 1.8 m high; the OSM 7 m outer part describes the approach/terrace ambiguously and is not used as a surveyed local foundation level. Memorial terrace, long stairs, tomb and rear hemicycle are outside this asset. Cityscape: not tested; Full 3D world: not tested.
